title: Update on my open-source Alpaca 0DTE SPY bot: first two green months after a rough summer (paper, full code + live dashboard)
author: Tiny-Ad-7916
selftext:
Back in July I open-sourced my 0DTE SPY options bot for Alpaca. That’s the full strategy, a 22-page manual, and a public dashboard. Some of you asked me to come back and report how it actually does over time, good or bad, so here’s the update.

**The short version:** September and October are its first two profitable months. All-time it’s still down.

Month by month, booked P&L on paper:

* May: −$1,238
* Jun: −$330
* Jul: −$691
* Aug: −$433
* Sep: **+$366**
* Oct (so far): **+$350**

Last 30 days: 102 trades, 50% win rate, profit factor 1.34, and 15 of 22 days green. The average winner is $55 and the average loser is $41. Since May 14 the totals are 700 trades and roughly −$1.1k, so it’s still digging out of the hole. I’m not going to pretend otherwise.

**What changed.** The win rate barely moved: it’s been about 47–50% the whole time, and honestly the entry signal by itself is close to a coin flip. What changed is everything around it:

1. **No new entries after noon.** Afternoons bled money all summer, so in late July I cut the entry window from 14:30 to 12:00. Theta and chop eat 0DTE alive after lunch.
2. **Stop for the day once I’m ahead.** New entries lock at +$125 realized or after 3 wins in a row. It first fired on 10/23.

**New in the repo:**

* Exit-parameter shadow (`exit_shadow.py`) and a “what if I hadn’t stopped” shadow for the daily gates (`gate_shadow.py`).
* Dashboard you can view over 30/60/90/180/360 days.
* An `o` console command that lists every option the bot is watching, with live quotes. That’s how I found half my strike window pointed at contracts that don’t exist, because the config assumed $0.50 SPY strikes. It turned out harmless in this setup, but check yours.

**Caveats:** this is paper trading, and two green months is a small sample. Part of it is almost certainly the market regime.

Repo: [https://github.com/milgar7969/alpaca-options-framework](https://github.com/milgar7969/alpaca-options-framework)  
Live dashboard: [https://milgar7969.github.io/spy-0dte-dashboard/](https://milgar7969.github.io/spy-0dte-dashboard/)

Built by me with Claude as a coding and analysis partner, same as before. Happy to answer questions. I’d especially like to hear from anyone who’s experienced with the Alpaca API.

Disclaimer: this is a personal project, not financial advice. All results are paper trading — simulated fills, no real money — and past performance, paper or live, does not guarantee future results. 0DTE options can lose 100% of the premium in minutes. If you run the code, you’re responsible for what it does with your account.
